scene: Your pocketed wrench activates three departure gates ahead.
picture: A flat side view along a bustling transit depot edge. Far left, a striped steam train sits puffing pink smoke. Left, the girl in her purple wheelchair pockets the glowing blue tool. Up high, a brass airship floats anchored to a pylon. Far right, an illuminated glass cylindrical elevator waits open.
shown: a striped steam train puffing sweet peppermint smoke at the far left platform
a brass airship tethered with ropes floating steadily up high
a transparent cylindrical elevator with glowing buttons waiting open at far right
